operator.name: Matembo Safaris and Tours
operator.note: TripAdvisor blocks automated scraping (HTTP 403). These seeds map Matembo's featured routes to verified TTB itineraries.

packages.pitch: Two days on the Great Ruaha River – elephants, lions and wild dogs from Matembo's home park.
Sunrise and full-day game drives along sandy river courses – our signature southern safari.
Four days in Tanzania's largest park with night drives and river-bank predator action.
Mikumi's hippo pools and Ruaha's baobab valleys – the best of southern Tanzania.
Ruaha game drives, Udzungwa forest walks and Mikumi plains in one private route.
Nyerere boat safaris through Ruaha river drives – the definitive southern Tanzania journey.
Tarangire elephants and Ngorongoro Crater in two days – ideal add-on from Arusha.
Serengeti plains and Ngorongoro caldera – Tanzania's most requested game-drive pairing.
Extended Serengeti time for migration crossings with crater finale.
Full-day Ngorongoro game drive – dense wildlife in Africa's largest intact caldera.
